stories.title: Microsoft pauses KB5002907 update after Office license deactivations
stories.summary: Microsoft has paused the rollout of the KB5002907 Microsoft 365 update after users report that it deactivated, or in some cases completely removed, perpetual Office 2016 and Office 2019 installations.

stories.title: Grand Paris Express metro opening faces fresh delay
stories.summary: After the delay to Line 15 announced in June, a further postponement was announced for the future automatic metro lines 16 and 17, north and east of Paris.

stories.title: Trump administration is trying to reshape election rules to its advantage ahead of midterm elections
stories.summary: The Supreme Court prevented Republicans on Friday from redrawing Missouri's electoral map to their benefit, but the party has managed to reshape districts in many other states. Meanwhile, the White House sought to purge voter rolls and limit mail-in voting.

stories.title: Fernandez saves set point, then sweeps Gibson aside to win Singapore title
stories.summary: Leylah Fernandez (No. 6) saved a set point against Talia Gibson and did not lose another game, winning 7-5, 6-0 to take the Singapore title. The Canadian, handed a wild card after a visa problem wrecked her plans for Brazil, lifted her sixth career trophy.

stories.title: Czechs beat Ukraine for 12th Billie Jean King Cup title
stories.summary: The Czech Republic ease past Ukraine to win the Billie Jean King Cup for the 12th time thanks to wins for 2026 Wimbledon finalists Karolina Muchova and Linda Noskova.

entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
